{{Quote|Choose the ''wrong'' pipe you'll be flash fried before you know what hit you.|Kidd Kareen, a Podracer pilot, describes the Doom Pipes|<ref name="CC" />}}
The '''Doom Pipes''' were a series of pipes that made up part of the [[Mon Gazza Maze/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]] course and its qualifiers. Many of the pipes ended in dead ends. At least one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] failed to even enter the pipes during a race that took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="CC" />
